moodle.bloatingBardsc: A measure of how full your stomach is. Currently holding 1 Liters.
moodle.superOverweightdsc: Had there been a study on this, you would be, by far, the fattest experiment to date. Your further journey into extremes of obesity further constrict your movement and health, even walking is now exhausting...
moodle.barelyMobiledsc: Your belly is threatening to press against the ground as you gorge, your heart is struggling to pump through all the lard and cholesterol in your system, and even standing is incredibly tiring!
moodle.blobdsc: You are more akin to a pile of waddling dough than any living being at this point, Belly firmly smushed against the floor and your thigh fat pushing your legs apart. Your breasts are pushing your arms to the sides along with this! The fact you've managed to eat this much is a miracle.
moodle.gigaBlobdsc: You are more akin to a pile of waddling dough than any living being at this point, Belly firmly smushed against the floor and your thigh fat pushing your legs apart. Your breasts are pushing your arms to the sides along with this! The fact you've managed to eat this much is a miracle.
moodle.overfeddsc: You've eaten more than you ever could before... you're absolutely going to start packing on pounds.
moodle.fatArmor0dsc: Your layers of fat provide a moderate amount of protection from cuts and bruises
moodle.fatArmor1dsc: Your over-abundant padding provides significant protection from harm
moodle.spoileddsc: You've eaten a LOT more than you ever did at the lab. Your standards might start to rise if you keep eating like this...
moodle.spoiled_startdsc: You were well fed before arrival, maybe a bit too well fed... Eating past your usual fullness will passively gain weight at an alarming rate.
moodle.foodDependantdsc: Eating INCREDIBLY well... too well, even. Your stomach has stretched and your feel quite a bit hungrier... though, it seems your metabolism has not even tried to catch up.
moodle.completeGluttondsc: Your binge eating and excessive indulgence has lead to your appetite surging, easily able to eat well more than most others, maybe even twice as much! You feel rather hungry most of the time...
moodle.foodVoiddsc: Practically a bag of pure hunger, you can eat WAY too much and still have room for more, you always feel hungry... though something about stuffing yourself like this feels... pleasant?
moodle.stuck1dsc: Your size is making it difficult to fit into tight spaces.
moodle.stuck2dsc: Your size has gotten you wedged into a tight space. you'll need to wiggle free.
moodle.slickeddsc: Slathered in a slippery coating that helps you squeeze through tight spaces with relative ease. Should last until it's cleaned off.
moodle.bloating0dsc: Your stomach feels a little tight, drunk some soda, or just ate or drank a bit much. Not comfortable, but it's not a big deal.
moodle.bloating1dsc: You feel really bloated, your guts keep getting tighter and tighter...
moodle.bloating2dsc: Your insides feel impossibly tight, your gut keeps feeling more and more swollen, and you can even feel your skin getting tighter from the pressure... are you sure whatever you're doing is a good idea?
moodle.jaw_installeddsc: Your jaw is now prosthetic, you can now eat and talk without issue, for now.

item.xl:stickofbutterdsc: Goes great on bread. Can be eaten or applied to the body as a makeshift lubricant.
item.xl:stickofbutterdsc1: Fattening, and most find it sickening to eat it by itself... why do you feel strangely compelled to eat it?
item.xl:stickofbutterdsc2: So tasty, you feel like you could eat this for every meal!
item.xl:stickofbutterdsc3: Decent as a snack, but you feel like you'd need a few more of these for a nice, round meal.
item.xl:stickofbutterdsc4: Greasy, filling, delicous. Your mouth is watering just looking at it.
item.xl:liposyringedsc: A generic looking graduated syringe that can inject fluid subcutaneously. A small yellow label reads 'FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY.'
item.xl:liposerumdsc: An experimental drug made by the Coporation in an attempt to help people who are underweight. Effects proved unpredictable. The question is why did it get sent here...?
item.xl:zabkahotdogdsc: A piece of sausage, wrapped in bread, and stuffed with cheese. Very good.
item.xl:pillsdsc: Unlabeled bottle of pills, there are some pills in here; however, you don't know what they do.
item.xl:pillsgainerforeigndsc: A somewhat tall, labeled bottle of pills. You cannot read the label, but the text says "misikeke pi kama suli", whatever that means is beyond you.
item.xl:friesdsc: Rather salty, crisp fries; A bit surprising how fresh they are, given how long they might've been sitting here.
item.xl:electricgrilldsc: A handy and portable electric grill powered by a large battery.
item.xl:gameboydsc: A basic, rather old looking gaming handheld. Could be useful for trade.
item.xl:marceBurgerdsc: A vaguely cat, vaguely fish shaped burger, seems rather filling.
item.xl:orbitzdsc: A rather old drink, has floating jelly balls in a somewhat thick, sugary drink; has very high sugar content, likely still safe to drink despite the 1999 expiry date.
item.xl:orbitz_emptydsc: A vintage bottle that used to hold Orbitz, can be used to store liquids.
item.xl:orbitz_viledsc: It's supposed to be clear, not brown. Throw this shit away.
item.xl:jawdsc: A makeshift jaw, for when yours gets completely blown off. Will work for awhile.
item.xl:dietpillbottledsc: A 100ml bottle of diet pills. the dosage is 20ml.
item.xl:dietpillsdsc: Pills which reduce your appetite and increase your metabolism for a time. They taste bitter and slightly sickening.
